title: Weight Space Programming for Vision Language Model Repair
read_level: full (arXiv HTML v2 dated 19 Nov 2026, Secs 1-8, Tables 1-4; supplementary ancillary file not read; figures as text only)
metadata_mismatch: Title punctuation: paper reads 'Weight-Space Programming for Vision–Language Model Repair' (hyphen and en dash), metadata has no hyphen/dash. Notes are from v2; v1 not read.
why_wsp: A coding agent (GPT-6 Astra via Codex CLI) reads the weights of damaged VLM checkpoints and writes a program that edits them, with no gradients, and each edit is audited weight-by-weight against the clean checkpoint.
domain: Vision-language model repair (spatial questions on synthetic scenes and GQA photographs)
editor: GPT-6 Astra (gpt-6-astra) via Codex CLI; high reasoning effort (low effort for SmolVLM sessions of Secs 4 and 7)
target: SmolVLM-256M (projector 576 x 12,288) and LFM2-VL-450M (projector 1,024 x 2,560), with planted faults in projector, vision encoder MLP and LM MLP
interface: code/tensor tools (agent writes program producing additive patch to at most 2M weights)
loop: closed-loop with feedback (limited aggregate scores: 24 scores/30 min SmolVLM, 8 scores/15 min LFM2-VL)
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: "Every patch changes 1.79 million weights, all of them damaged and 99.74% of all damaged weights" (Sec 4.1, SmolVLM unrounded); combined fault 'touches 0.7% of SmolVLM's weights and 0.2% of LFM2-VL's' (Sec 3)

headline_results.quote: six sessions on three checkpoints change only damaged weights and raise spatial accuracy from 38.5% to 83.9% (clean: 83.3%)
eight sessions on two checkpoints do the same and raise accuracy from 55.5% to 72.5% (clean: 75.0%)
in thirteen of these fourteen sessions it returns every rescaled weight to its exact clean value
On SmolVLM five of six sessions return no edit ... accuracy rises by 3.6 points, against 17.1 from the unrounded copies
The difference of 19.01 points is positive on all six checkpoints, with a two-sided 95% t interval ... of 8.97 to 29.05

headline_results.claim: Fixed script does most of the work
Gradient fitting vs agent on rounded
headline_results.quote: Adam gains 36.46 points and LoRA 25.26, against 19.66 for the hinted agent
Without a hint and within these budgets, the agent did not find these faults on either model.
P3 restores all 655,360 rescaled weights of L2 exactly

cost.quote: Session budget | 24 scores, 30 min | 8 scores, 15 min

baselines_and_controls: Rounded-weight control; marks on damage vs on decoys; random low bits; placebo hint (sign bits); row-norm hint; fixed grid-fit script; histogram and row-norm rules; Adam and rank-8 LoRA gradient fits; random control edits of the same size; healthy (unfaulted) checkpoints; frozen-program transfer to unseen checkpoints.
runs_and_variance: SmolVLM conditions over 3-6 checkpoints with 1-2 sessions each; most LFM2-VL conditions a single session on one checkpoint. Quote: 'every LFM2-VL condition has one session on one checkpoint, and differences of a few answers between such conditions are within what random control edits produce' (Sec 8)
robustness_of_edits: Side-effect question sets (colors, reworded spatial, quantities) checked; frozen programs tested on unseen checkpoints without feedback; no fine-tuning/quantization survival tests
verification: Weight-by-weight audit against clean checkpoint (bit-exact restoration counts); byte-for-byte reproduction of patch from frozen program; exact McNemar and sign-flip tests on some comparisons.
memorization_vs_reasoning: Paper shows repairs depended on a numerical artifact (nonzero float32 low bits on BF16-grid weights) rather than on what the weights compute: 'None of the four requires knowing what the weights compute.'
limitations_stated: Two models, one agent model, synthetic scenes and one GQA question family; many single sessions; hint and baselines post hoc; audits need a clean reference that real failures lack; planted faults may not resemble natural failures.
code_or_data: none found (supplement is an arXiv ancillary file)

notes_for_survey: Identifies a confound for planted-fault repair studies: faults computed in float32 on BF16 weights leave low-bit traces the agent exploits. Recommends reporting number format and including a rounded control.
